milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting 3 glass in a V-shape at the crafting table produces glass bottles that end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with zero glass bottles, so having at least 1 confirms the craft occurred. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player still possesses the leather_chestplate (confirming it wasn't lost) combined with position_near_with_facing toward the anvil at spawn-relative (3, 0, -2). The player must navigate to and face the anvil to use it for repair. Anvil repairs may not trigger craft_item events, and there is no rule type to check item damage values or detect consumed materials. Checking proximity+facing to the anvil confirms the player interacted with it, and inventory_has confirms the chestplate is retained. Together these provide the best available detection for anvil repair completion.
